note: Who wins the games that are undecided on day 150? The same twelve medium land maps, both seats, with a day limit of 300: the standard, and the standard with townWorth and the campaign from twice the strongest enemy hero. In 549 long games 38 % stood undecided on day 150 - three towns against four, armies level, the enemy's income higher, our garrisons full. The target is games won, not games not lost: this shows how many of the undecided ones are won or lost in the end. Read the timeline for the state on day 150 (arena/timeline.py, arena/metrics.py).
